Name: Jeiel, Porter
Summary: Levite porter appointed at the bringing up of the ark, with psalteries and harps.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:18; 1 Chronicles 15:21; 1 Chronicles 16:5: Levite porter appointed at the bringing up of the ark, with psalteries and harps.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
